outcomes.limit: Not absolute or specific force; no pretreatment function trajectory

outcomes.unit: UNRESOLVED: main metres; native S1D centimetres
outcomes.limit: 15-minute stimulated treadmill performance; selection from cohort n6 unexplained

outcomes.direction: higher lean percentage, lower fat percentage with beta
selected ETC proteins up; Mss51 mRNA down; Yy1 mRNA/protein up

outcomes.positive: Selected ETC proteins and superoxide respond. Fig3C direct Mss51-OE versus Mss51-OE+betaine comparisons mark increased maximal respiration and spare respiratory capacity (**P<.01; caption n=5–6). Separate Fig5B direct betaine comparisons show increased basal/maximal OCR, ATP production, spare capacity and proton leak (***P<.001; n=4).
outcomes.null_or_limit: Mitochondrial number and PGC1alpha not rescued; Fig3C direct basal-respiration, proton-leak and ATP-production comparisons are unmarked. Fig5B increased proton leak does not itself establish improved ATP efficiency or a beneficial endpoint.

comparative_judgment: Actual controlled muscle-function outcomes justify reserve status beyond a generic osmolyte hypothesis. Mixed small healthy-human and aged-mouse evidence does not establish MVA superiority. Niacin human muscle NAD/open-label strength and apitegromab pediatric disease motor evidence are distinct comparator dimensions, neither proof of BUB1B efficacy.
